title: Test commit reachability
responsibility: Check whether a commit is the tip itself or an ancestor of it.

inputs.name: githubReaches.client
inputs.description: Transport used to validate access and compare `commit` with `tip` on GitHub. It is used only when the parsed SHAs differ.

inputs.name: githubReaches.input
inputs.description: The repository tip SHA and candidate commit SHA to compare. Both are parsed as SHAs, and equal values return true without a transport call.

outputs.name: githubReaches
outputs.description: Resolves to true when the candidate is the tip or the merge base of an `ahead` or `identical` comparison; otherwise it resolves to false. A comparison 404 returns false, while parsing or transport failures reject the promise.

errors.name: ZodError
errors.description: Parsing either SHA or the comparison response rejects when the value does not match its schema.

errors.name: GitHub reachability request failure
errors.description: A rejection from `client.check()` or `client.request()` propagates; the function does not convert transport failures into a reachability result.
